# Ckmeans.1d.dp matched to the lex1dx v10 protocol

One warm-up and 3 timed reps; times are medians, in seconds. Inputs, seeds, and files are those of the v10 scaling pack (`run/gen_synth.py`, SeedSequence(2048, spawn_key=(stream_id, N)); audio is the v10 Dharini Abhogi recording, N = 8,168,256). `Ckmeans.1d.dp` ran with `method = "linear"` (fastest exact method, O(kn) after sort, O(kn) memory). **Post-sort time (`input=sorted`)** is a call on an array already sorted with `std::sort` (the same sort as v10, timed separately as `sort_s`). `Ckmeans.1d.dp` still sorts internally; that internal sort is on already-sorted data and is **not excluded**. Unsorted fits (`input=raw`) include the internal sort of the unsorted array, matching the archived Table 4 column. SSE is scored on the raw sorted values with the same two-pass long-double `raw_sse` as v10 `scale_cell.cpp`. Exact SSE* is unweighted Grønlund wilber-interp (interpolation search, the v10 patched solver) scored with the same function. REE is (SSE − SSE*) / SSE* × 100. Peak RSS is the cell process (`wait4` / `getrusage`), in MiB. A cell is skipped, and recorded as `status=skipped`, if the estimated peak RSS exceeds 100 GiB (`LEX_MEM_CAP_GIB`) or the estimated wall time for the warm-up plus reps exceeds 7200 s (`LEX_TIME_CAP_S`). The estimator is a fit to the archived Ckmeans.1d.dp 4.3.6 runs at N = 2^20: RSS ≈ 0.22 GiB + 16 bytes × N × k, and time ≈ 21.6 s × (N / 2^20) × (k / 512) per fit.
